title: The Ghost Ship Mystery
facts: The Canadian brigantine Dei Gratia found the Mary Celeste adrift off the Azores on 4 December 1872.
The ship was built on Spencers Island, Nova Scotia and launched as Amazon on 18 May 1861.
Its original dimensions were 99.3 ft length, 25.5 ft breadth, 11.7 ft depth and 198.42 gross tons.
After a 1872 refit its length was 103 ft, breadth 25.7 ft, depth 16.2 ft and displacement 282.28 tonnes.
The vessel left New York for Genoa on 7 November 1872, was still fully provisioned and its cargo of alcohol was intact when found.
The crew's personal belongings were undisturbed and the lifeboat was missing when the ship was discovered.
In 1885 the captain deliberately wrecked Mary Celeste off Haiti in an attempted insurance fraud.
The abandonment of the ship in 1872 remains unexplained; theories such as alcohol fumes, waterspouts, or paranormal causes are only interpretations.

lines.say: In 1872, Dei Gratia finds Mary Celeste.
She drifts silent near the Azores.
Built on Spencers Island, launched as Amazon.
Crew still left New York fully provisioned.
Personal items remain untouched in cabins.
What mystery still haunts this ghost ship?
